name: Escape Tsunami For Cats
desc:
Welcome to Escape Tsunami for Cats! 🐻

Run fast and steal Cats! 🏃
Avoid tsunamis when they come! 🌊
Stay alive and collect many Cats! ⚡
Boost your speed or carry limit with items from the Gear Shop! ⚙️
Upgrade your character and get more cash! 💸
Upgrade your plot to unlock more slots and place extra characters! 🏗️
Trade or gift your characters with friends and grow together! 🎁

Your Cats earn cash OFFLINE! 💤

Like the game and join the group for more! 👍
